step2_decision.reasonForThe40Refusing: Real, data-blocked. The 3,376-parcel zoningDistrict-dependent residual (reconciled above) is a known, already-tracked gap, not a slating decision this lane can affect. Out of scope per dispatch (fixing the residual is a different lane's job).
step2_decision.reasonForThe5PassingParcelAreaSqFtPairs: NOT slated despite passing, because slating them would be a vacuous write. Evidence: every existing PARCEL_RECORD_SLATE entry has a dedicated *ServeCutover.ts wrapper (or, for the cadRoll six, attachCadRollOverlaysToFacets) that actually calls resolveAllowlist for that exact rail_key -- repo-wide grep for resolveAllowlist call sites returns exactly the 13 known wrapper files plus parcelRecordAllowlist.ts/parcelGateVerdictRead.ts themselves. No wrapper exists for parcelAreaSqFt (or for setbackRules/maxHeightFt/maxLotCoveragePct/maxFootprintSqFt, though those all fail the gate so this is moot for them at this checkpoint). computeTier1Envelope (nodeFacetBakeTier1.ts:92-122), the program's own named root-cause function, never populates parcelAreaSqFt on either of its two branches (both status:'declined'), so there is also no legacy path for this rail -- unlike every rail L1 audited, neither path currently exists in this repo's serve layer for parcelAreaSqFt. Adding it to the slate would satisfy the completion predicate's text while changing nothing any customer-facing route serves -- exactly the 'runs perfectly, every test passes, cannot succeed on any branch' defect class this program's own preamble names as its reason for existing. Confirmed by the planner as the correct call, not scope discipline for its own sake: a coherent wrapper-building lane would need to cover five rails (setbackRules, maxHeightFt, maxLotCoveragePct, maxFootprintSqFt, parcelAreaSqFt), not one, and parcelAreaSqFt is the least customer-relevant of the nine (geometric lot area, not setbacks/buildable envelope).

wrapperCoverageFinding.shape: A clean inverse across the 9 written rails: the one rail-group WITH a serve-side wrapper (setbackFrontFt, representative of all 4 setback siblings via setbacksFactServeCutover.ts) fails the gate on every county. wrapperCoverageFinding.backlogItem: Building parcelAreaSqFtFactServeCutover.ts (and eventually wrappers for the other four wrapper-less rails, and wiring into the shared response-assembly path) is real, non-trivial follow-on scope -- named here for whoever scopes the next lane, not started by this one.
